142    public static function randomName($pool, $n)
143    {
144        $name = '';
145
146        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; ++$i) {
147            $name .= static::randomElement($pool);
148        }
149
150        return $name;
151    }
152

168    /**
169     * @param string $gender Person::GENDER_MALE || Person::GENDER_FEMALE
170     *
171     * @see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Identification_Card_(Republic_of_China)
172     *
173     * @return string Length 10 alphanumeric characters, begins with 1 latin character (birthplace),
174     *                1 number (gender) and then 8 numbers (the last one is check digit).
175     */
176    public function personalIdentityNumber($gender = null)
177    {
178        $birthPlace = self::randomKey(self::$idBirthplaceCode);
179        $birthPlaceCode = self::$idBirthplaceCode[$birthPlace];
180
181        $gender = ($gender != null) ? $gender : self::randomElement([self::GENDER_FEMALE, self::GENDER_MALE]);
182        $genderCode = ($gender === self::GENDER_MALE) ? 1 : 2;
183
184        $randomNumberCode = self::randomNumber(7, true);
185
186        $codes = str_split($birthPlaceCode . $genderCode . $randomNumberCode);
187        $total = 0;
188
189        foreach ($codes as $key => $code) {
190            $total += $code * self::$idDigitValidator[$key];
191        }
192
193        $checkSumDigit = 10 - ($total % 10);
194
195        if ($checkSumDigit == 10) {
196            $checkSumDigit = 0;
197        }
198
199        return $birthPlace . $genderCode . $randomNumberCode . $checkSumDigit;
200    }
